messages:
alex: Heads-up — ACME asked to move their SSO pilot up and wants tenant-level model pinning available by their pilot start. This would bump this feature in front of a few V1 items and likely trigger a timeline rewind. Need a quick sync on what we can fence and what to drop.
maria: Do we have a clear acceptance criteria from ACME or just 'model pinning'?
alex: They explicitly said: per-tenant model selection + audit logs for model choices. Not asking for Dedicated yet. Main ask is pinning + ability to roll back a tenant.
jin: Pinning itself is small: routing layer + tenant override config. Risks are rollout surface and KV invalidation for caches. Rough estimate: 2 sprints to do safe canary + rollback hooks if we do it end-to-end. Spike could confirm 1d.
sam: UX: admin page + simple per-tenant toggle + a visible 'pinned model' status. Can do a v0 wireframe in a day. Errors need to be clear (fallback model, rejected pin).
kat: ACME pushed on timelines in the call — they're willing to sign a committed pilot if we can ship by their target. This is revenue-adjacent; sales is flagging urgency.
maria: Proposal: ship an MVP that includes: (1) pinning API (per-tenant override), (2) simple admin UI for pin/unpin, (3) basic audit log entries for pin actions. Defer per-tenant telemetry dashboards, long-retention audit storage, and dedicated routing rules to V1. Thoughts?
jin: +1 from infra if we scope it to: runtime flag + a tenant config table + migration path for cache invalidation. Need a spike to validate conflict cases (pinned + routing policies).
alex: Quick implementation note (Jin): example of suggested config shape:
```
{ "tenant_id": "acme", "pinned_model": "redwood-3b-q4", "pinned_until": "2025-12-01T00:00:00Z" }
```
This should be small and not touch the global routing table.
kat: If we can commit to that MVP, I'll take the ask doc and draft a pilot contract. Could unlock reserved capacity later.
maria: Ok — action items: Jin: 1d spike (conflicts + cache invalidation), Sam: wireframe v0 (1d), Alex: update milestone+rollback wording, Kat: draft ACME pilot ask. Sync in 2pm huddle to decide final fence.
deploy-bot: calendar invite created for 2025-05-07 14:00 (product sync).
maria: 2pm works for me.
jin: Starting spike now, will post notes in the thread.
sam: Will drop quick Figma link in the channel by EOD.
alex: Thanks — if spike shows >3d risk we revert to 'pinning API only' and push UI to v1. Let's be pragmatic on what counts as MVP. :rocket:
